purpose: Replicate the observed native functional preservation regressions under the same fixed-length generation mechanism with four newly specified base seeds, before attributing them to recurrent write damage or training a new architecture.

generation.change: Only the base seeds change. Preserve the existing namespace, schedules, record-index values,162-record prompts,four tail cells,four value versions,three roles and complete deterministic evaluation order.
generation.orchestration: Use explicit plan-aware registration and evaluation. Preserve the already audited discovery sources; do not relabel seeds or cases to pass discovery-specific checks.

required_data_gate: Before any replica-model inference, reconstruct and freeze all576 executable examples and token/record registrations, protocol/generator/runtime/tokenizer/checkpoint hashes. Verify identical2865-token prompts, causal positions, suffixes and value-only tail changes. Freeze the exact evaluation registry.
required_runtime_gate: Use the unchanged local text-only eager BF16 native model, unrestricted greedy maximum12 tokens and gold3-digit NLL. Independently audit operational smoke first, actual six-layer history access, native replay and full loaded-state before/after hashes. No adapter or training.
primary_recurrence_rule: Report each primary contrast separately. A primary contrast recurs only if its answer-invariant toggle regresses at least two distinct new base streams; four value siblings count once. Report baseline errors, rescues and all denominators. Passing either does not establish a damaged recurrent pathway.
secondary_reports: Report the complete three-load/four-cell/three-role table and the same30 preservation contrasts, all target-update pairs, all-value functional units and four-stream cluster tables. Do not select only correct baselines or replace a failed primary with a secondary result.
interpretation: Replication of a functional symptom under a fixed generator, not confirmation of a new architecture, unseen templates or a scientific novelty claim. No independent-n576 inference.
decision_rule: If neither primary meets the recurrence rule, report nonreplication and defer new write-locality architecture training. If either recurs, execute only the separately registered aligned event-path diagnostic before considering a method.
implementation_status: Protocol only; replica dataset, plan-aware runner and model inference not yet implemented/executed at registration.
